item.title: Good Morning Family - 22 July 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Wednesday, the 22 July.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 14 degrees.
There is about a 25 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is U.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter U?
. . . . . . . .
